en.sayed-ali-raza: O my Allāh! we have come out to Thee when the years of drought have crowded over us like (herd of) thin camels, and rain clouds have abandoned us.
Thou art the hope for the afflicted and succour for the seeker. We call Thee when the people have lost hopes, cloud has been denied and cattle have died,
that do not seize us for our deeds and do not catch us for our sins,
and spread Thy mercy over us through raining clouds, rain-fed blossoming, amazing vegetation, and heavy down-pours
with which all that was dead regains life and all that was lost returns.
